narrative: 为一个篇章收尾。地貌获胜。
人物在足够长的时间里保持可追踪，以证明连续性，随后土地、城市或军队占据画面。时机决定这种感觉是释然还是被抹去。
如果一场戏开场仍需要面部特写，这就是错误的工具；如果一台伸缩摇臂（Technocrane）升起几十英尺就足够，也不该用它。如果你始终没有离开人体尺度的空中高度，那你做的其实是摇臂上升（Crane Up）。
how: 直升机、高空无人机或虚拟摄影机沿着上升并后退的路径运动。在比例不断变化的过程中保持一个可辨认的锚点。
地平线可以保持水平。提示词：aerial pullback, camera rising and receding until the figure is a speck in geography, helicopter or high drone grammar.
when: 当地貌必须占据主导来为篇章收尾时使用它。具体情境：山脊上的骑手渐渐化为沙漠中的一个印记。
如果最后一个画面仍然是同一人物的中景全身镜头，就不要拉远。
vs: 摇臂上升（Crane Up）从人体高度的机械臂上开始，可能只揭示出一个广场。极远景（Extreme Long Shot）可以是那个结尾画面的静态呈现。
航拍推近（Aerial Push In）是相反的路径，从地图推向人物。航拍拉远则是高度加后退，直到土地占据画面。
examples_film: 《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》让沙漠的尺度既抹去又定义了一个人物。《指环王》（The Lord of the Rings）运用高空拉远，让军队化为山脉与平原中的印记。
这是把场景交托给土地的语法，而不是一座可以照搬的山。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是摇臂上升，或直接切到一个极远景。破绽在于升起的幅度只有小摇臂（Jib）那么大，或者比例发生了跳跃。
修正方法：从高空持续上升并后退，人物始终保持可追踪，最终由土地主导画面。

faq.q: What is Aerial Pullback in film?
faq.a: 这是一个高空摄影机不断后退并上升的镜头，直到人物或建筑在地貌中变得渺小，将场景交托给地理环境。
摇臂上升是地面上机械臂的运动，通常结束于一个街区或广场。航拍拉远则从直升机或高空无人机的高度出发，直到地图占据主导。

faq.q: When should I use Aerial Pullback?
faq.a: 当一个篇章应该以土地、军队或城市收尾，而不是以面部收尾时使用。不要把它当作装饰性的无人机悬停来用。

faq.q: How do I prompt Aerial Pullback for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写出如下要素：camera rises and pulls back from [Subject] until landscape dominates, helicopter or high drone, figure remains trackable, then becomes a speck.

narrative: The figure remains trackable long enough to prove continuity, then land, city, or army takes the frame. Timing decides whether the feeling is release or erasure.
It is the wrong tool at the start of a scene that still needs a face, and the wrong tool if a Technocrane's tens of feet would suffice. If you never leave human-scale air, you craned.
how: Helicopter, high drone, or virtual camera on a rising, receding path. Keep a readable anchor as scale changes.
Horizon can stay level. Prompt an aerial pullback, camera rising and receding until the figure is a speck in geography, helicopter or high drone grammar.
when: Use it to close a chapter when geography must win. Concrete beat: a rider on a ridge becoming a mark in a desert.
Do not pull back if the last frame is still a medium-full of the same person.
vs: A Crane Up starts at human height on an arm and may only reveal a square. An Extreme Long Shot can be a still of that end frame.
An Aerial Push In is the reverse path, map to person. Aerial pullback is altitude plus retreat until land owns the picture.
examples_film: Lawrence of Arabia lets desert scale erase and define a figure. The Lord of the Rings uses high pullbacks so companies become marks in ranges and plains.
Grammar of handing a scene to land, not a mountain to clone.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Crane Up or a cut to an Extreme Long Shot. The tell is a jib-sized lift, or a jump in scale.
The fix: continuous rise and recede from altitude, figure remaining trackable, land dominating the end.

faq.q: What is Aerial Pullback in film?
faq.a: It is a high camera receding and rising until a person or building becomes small in a landscape, handing the scene to geography.
Crane up is an arm on the ground, often ending on a city block or a square. Aerial pullback works from helicopter or high-drone height until the map wins.

faq.q: When should I use Aerial Pullback?
faq.a: When a chapter should end on land, army, or city rather than on a face. Do not use it as a decorative drone hover.
